The equation for the reaction of magnesium with oxygen is shown.
2Mg  +  O2→  2MgO
In an experiment, 6.0g of magnesium is reacted with excess oxygen.
Which mass of magnesium oxide, MgO, is produced?
A
10g
B
20g
C
40g
D
80g
